world.title: US Midterms: Can Democrats Take The Senate? New Poll Shows Blues Ahead In Two Key Races, Two Toss-Ups
world.summary: CNN polling indicates that Democrats are leading in key Senate races in Michigan and Texas, while Maine and Kansas are classified as toss-ups. With the midterm elections approaching in less than a week, the results of these races could significantly impact the balance of power in the Senate, as both parties vie for control.

world.title: US First Lady praised for Oleshky relief truce as Moscow strikes Ukrainian commuters
world.summary: Russia and Ukraine praised US First Lady Melania Trump for brokering a truce in the Russian-held town of Oleshky. The agreement aims to facilitate the delivery of food and medicines to the area, which is experiencing severe deprivation. Additionally, the truce allows for the evacuation of hundreds of residents, marking a significant humanitarian effort amid ongoing conflict.

world.title: Trump moves to end H-1B visa deference: What it means for Indians stuck in the Green Card backlog
world.summary: Trump's recent move to end H-1B visa deference impacts Indian professionals in the U.S., as H-1B extensions are vital for maintaining legal status. This change complicates their journey toward permanent residency, or green cards, amidst an already lengthy backlog. The decision raises concerns for those relying on these extensions to secure their future in the country.

business.title: IndiGo CEO says ‘no choice’ but to consider fare hikes as fuel costs surge
business.summary: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh has indicated that the airline may need to increase ticket prices due to a significant rise in fuel costs, which have surged by 67.2 percent compared to the previous year. Walsh stated that the airline has “no choice” but to consider fare hikes as it navigates the financial pressures stemming from these escalating expenses.

business.title: IndiGo CEO says airline has ‘no choice’ but to raise fares as fuel bill jumps 67%
business.summary: IndiGo's CEO Willie Walsh announced that the airline must raise fares due to a 67.2% increase in fuel costs, totaling nearly ₹9,967 crore. The airline managed to recover only about 60% of this increase through fares and other measures. IndiGo reported a net loss of ₹1,879 crore for the September quarter, highlighting the financial strain.

business.title: New Electric Scooter Spied Testing With Car-Like 225L Boot Space
business.summary: The Qargos F9 electric cargo scooter has been spotted testing, featuring a 6.1 kWh battery pack, 225L boot space, and a 120 kg cargo capacity. It offers a range of 150 km, highlighting the growth of India's electric mobility sector. This model represents the expanding genre of electric scooters designed specifically for cargo and delivery purposes.

technology.title: I installed One UI 9 on my Galaxy S24; it feels like I got a Galaxy S26 upgrade for free
technology.summary: Samsung started rolling out One UI 9 for older Galaxy phones in October 2026. An installation on the Galaxy S24 Ultra revealed that many features from the upcoming Galaxy S26, particularly AI tools, are now available on the two-year-old device. The update provides significant enhancements, making the S24 Ultra feel like a newer model with advanced capabilities.

technology.title: Flipkart Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026: iPhone 17 at ₹79,999; iPhone Air at ₹99,900 - check offers
technology.summary: Flipkart's Big Bang Diwali Sale 2026 commenced on October 28 and will last for 20 days, featuring discounts of up to 60% on various products. The iPhone 17 is priced at ₹79,999, while the iPhone 15 is available for ₹59,999. The sale includes offers on laptops, wearables, and home appliances, enhancing the shopping experience for customers.

technology.title: Cheap Code, Expensive Confidence
technology.summary: A recent project involved using a coding agent to create Task Viewer, a non-critical plug-in for IBM Bob, aimed at assisting internal users. While it provided convenience, the experience highlighted the importance of selecting appropriate automation tools and developing the necessary expertise to evaluate their effectiveness. This raises concerns about balancing cost-effectiveness with the reliability of automated solutions.

sports.title: Duckett 167 drives England to 386 for 5 in dead rubber
sports.summary: England scored 386 for 5 against Sri Lanka in their ODI Tri-Series match. Ben Duckett led the innings with an impressive 167 runs, supported by Tom Banton's 74. This performance follows a high-scoring match in Rawalpindi, showcasing England's batting strength. The match is part of the ongoing series, although it is considered a dead rubber.

sports.title: Ranji Highlights: 8-fers for Kotian, Bhut; Bengal thrash Kerala
sports.summary: On Day 4 of the Ranji Trophy, Kotian and Bhut each took eight wickets, leading their teams to victory. Mumbai chased down a 97-run target against Haryana in just 11 overs, with Angkrish Raghuvanshi scoring 67 not out off 39 balls. Bengal secured a dominant win over Kerala, showcasing strong performances throughout the matches.

sports.title: SA vs AUS: Josh Inglis becomes first Australian cricketer to achieve this rare feat in all three formats
sports.summary: Josh Inglis made history as the first Australian cricketer to score centuries in all three formats of the game. He achieved this milestone with his second Test century during the third Test against South Africa at Newlands. Australia was bowled out for 429 runs on Day 3 of the series-deciding match, solidifying Inglis's remarkable accomplishment.

health.title: Is your child holding a screen too close? Here's why eye experts are concerned
health.summary: Dr. Carreen Pakrasi emphasized that children's eye health is affected by screen distance, outdoor exposure, and blinking habits, not just screen time limits. The increasing use of digital devices among children has raised concerns about myopia, or short-sightedness. Experts advocate for healthier visual habits to protect eyesight, highlighting the need for a comprehensive approach to eye care.

health.title: Bharat Biotech Slashes Malaria Vaccine Price by Forty Percent
health.summary: Bharat Biotech International Limited (BBIL) has partnered with Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, and UNICEF to reduce the price of the RTS,S/AS01 malaria vaccine by 40%. This equitable pricing agreement aims to enhance accessibility to the vaccine, which was developed by GSK and is manufactured by BBIL. The move is intended to support global malaria prevention efforts.

health.title: Apollo Hospitals Highlights AI
health.summary: Apollo Hospitals has showcased its AI-assisted stroke care programme on World Stroke Day, October 29. The initiative focuses on rapid diagnosis, advanced interventions, and rehabilitation to improve patient outcomes. The hospital emphasizes the critical role of timely diagnosis and coordinated treatment in managing strokes effectively. This programme aims to enhance overall care for stroke patients in Hyderabad.

science.title: US 100th Spacewalk 2026: NASA astronauts including Anil Menon upgrade ISS solar power system | Watch Live
science.summary: NASA's U.S. Spacewalk 100 is scheduled for October 29, 2026, featuring astronauts Anil Menon and Joshua Kutryk. They will upgrade the International Space Station's solar power system by installing a new solar array to enhance its energy supply. The event will be livestreamed for public viewing, marking a significant milestone in space exploration and ISS maintenance.

science.title: NIH selects KGL to develop platform for replication research journal
science.summary: The US National Institutes of Health (NIH) has chosen KnowledgeWorks Global (KGL) to create the submission and publishing platform for the Journal of Replication and Reproducibility (JRR). This journal will focus on publishing replication research, null results, and studies aimed at enhancing the transparency and reliability of the scientific record, promoting rigorous scientific practices.

science.title: How new microscopy platform enables deeper brain imaging
science.summary: A new microscopy platform developed by Rockefeller University aims to improve brain imaging by addressing limitations of three-photon microscopy. While this technique reduces background fluorescence and allows deeper imaging, it risks overheating and damaging tissue due to high laser power. The new approach seeks to enhance imaging depth without compromising tissue integrity, potentially advancing neuroscience research significantly.

entertainment.title: Janhvi Kapoor Makes Her Relationship Official And Shares Wedding Plans
entertainment.summary: Janhvi Kapoor has officially confirmed her relationship with Shikhar Pahariya during her appearance on Koffee With Karan 9. She discussed her love life candidly and indicated that marriage is not on the horizon for her in the next two to three years. Kapoor's comments provide insight into her current relationship status and future plans regarding marriage.

entertainment.title: BREAKING: Ram Gopal Varma in LEGAL TROUBLE over Rs. 29.67 crores! Production house warns filmmakers, OTT platforms against dealing with RGV without NOC
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma is facing legal issues over a financial dispute involving Rs. 29.67 crores, as stated by Eclatant Films Private Limited. The production house has issued a public notice demanding payment and has warned filmmakers and OTT platforms against engaging with Varma without a No Objection Certificate (NOC). The situation has raised significant concerns in the industry.

entertainment.title: 'Madhubala and Dilip Kumar are burried close to each other at Juhu Kabrastan, just 5-10 metres apart,' reveals her sister Madhur Bhushan talking about their break-up: 'She died when she turned 36'
entertainment.summary: Madhubala and Dilip Kumar, iconic figures in Hindi cinema, are buried close to each other at Juhu Kabrastan, just 5-10 meters apart. Madhubala's sister, Madhur Bhushan, revealed that Madhubala died at the age of 36. Their relationship, marked by romance and subsequent separation, continues to evoke interest and speculation long after their passing.
